dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature fitting a smooth spline along the trailing edge from the posterior ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High-degree acute incline relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width slightly exceeds maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous semi-circular convexity of the melon region transition.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered beak with low longitudinal length relative to the cranial thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum extension.

other_distinctive_markers: Intense cyan-hued bioluminescent saturation across the majority of the dorsal and lateral pixel surfaces.
